shvetashvatara_chapter2_verse3.title: Shvetashvatara Chapter 2 Verse 3
shvetashvatara_chapter2_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Shvetashvatara, Chapter 2.
shvetashvatara_chapter2_verse3.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Shvetashvatara Upanishad, Chapter 2, Verse 3, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
shvetashvatara_chapter2_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
